capabilities: Check title and body word counts, placeholders, local images, external links and Obsidian-specific syntax against per-platform rules
Insert, detect and safely update a per-platform sign-off (文末落款) at the end of the body
Copy the note body as plain text with Markdown symbols stripped, or as Markdown with Obsidian syntax converted
Detect the target platform from a note property (e.g. platform: 小红书) or folder rules
Restrict checking and copying to a designated body section (正文) when the note contains cover text, title drafts and image lists
extras: Runs fully offline with no AI calls. Not yet in the community plugin directory, so manual installation is recommended for now (version 0.1.0). The author lists companion plugins (发布前合规检查, GEO 写作检查) and a Gitee mirror for users in China.
motivation: The authors state the tool comes from checks they repeatedly did in their brand-planning client work: "这些开源工具来自我们在实际项目里反复做的工作" (these open-source tools come from work we repeatedly do in real projects).
problem: Obsidian has no way to verify a draft meets a specific platform's title/body length limits, format restrictions, and fixed sign-off before you paste it into that platform's editor.

relations.evidence: 广告法风险可以配合发布前合规检查使用

summary: Pre-publication checker that validates a note against a target Chinese publishing platform (lengths, formats, placeholders, sign-off) and copies it ready to paste.
